triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:ui` (kanban lane statistics) · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Feature · a lane's `sum` statistic adds up only the loaded cards (50 per lane on a paged board), so a long lane shows a partial figure, now labelled 「loaded cards」 by #36411. The ask is to total the whole lane in the query → p2 as filed · size S.

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Scope addition (2026-11-22T17:16Z): this card also carries the board's **average, minimum and maximum** lane statistics, not only the whole-lane sum. PR #36411 (card #36370) keeps those three out of `KanbanLaneSummary` until a server lane read exists, because over the loaded cards of a windowed lane they would be wrong with no honest marker. Done-when gains one line: `summary` admits `avg`, `min` and `max`, computed by the same server lane read as the whole-lane sum, with a pin for each. Source: delta contract review 7082698044 on #36411.

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

One more item for this card, from #36411's delta review 7082698044 (N4). The board's yes / no exclusion from a lane sum is two inline type literals, in the lint rule `kanbanSummaryRefusal` and in plugin-list `laneStatisticSums`, instead of the spec's boolean field class. A third boolean-class type would slip through both. When this card reworks the lane statistic, read that class from the spec in both places. In the same pass, fix the stale comment near `validate-list-view-field-refs.test.ts:328` ("prints a sum of 0").
